_about: Phrases a newer owner law killed. A live rule, skill or CLAUDE.md line that still teaches one fails scripts/rules-drift-check.mjs. Lines that start with Never / Do not, lines with a red X, lines under a Never or Banned heading, and lines that say retired / removed / dead / banned / superseded are treated as quoting the phrase and are allowed. Add 'allow' ({file, line}) for any other exception. Default paths: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules, .claude/rules, .cursor/skills, docs/rules.

phrases.killedBy: fundhub-company-name (owner law 2026-09-21): the company is Fundhub
phrases.fix: Write Fundhub. The domain stays fundhub.ai.

phrases.killedBy: CLAUDE.md 'GitHub is canonical. GitLab is retired' (owner-set 2026-10-05)
phrases.fix: Use GitHub: remote origin, node scripts/github-push-whole-repo.mjs, GITHUB_TOKEN.
